title: Closing Desk Guidance: Reserved Closing Cost Credits on a Mortgage Loan File Closing Disclosure
content:
The closing cost credit line of the initial Closing Disclosure on a Mortgage Loan File is read from the Closing Cost Credit records: the entries on the customer's closing cost credits (award entries, guarantee payout entries, and the entries that applied a credit at closing, reduced it or forfeited its balance), and the credits reserved against the file with their program's fixed credit amount.

**Rule.** Where award entries have been booked on the customer's closing cost credits, the standing balance of those credits is added, that is the award and guarantee payout entries less the entries that applied, reduced or forfeited them; where no award has been booked but closing cost credits against the file are in reserved status, the fixed credit amount of every program reserved against the file (one credit per program) is added up as an estimate, a percentage or guarantee program counting 0.00; where neither holds, nothing is added.

| Closing Cost Credit records | Added to the lender credits |
|---|---|
| award entries booked on any of the customer's closing cost credits | the standing balance: award and guarantee payout entries, less the entries that applied, reduced or forfeited them |
| no award booked; one or more credits against the file in reserved status | the fixed credit amounts of every program reserved against the file, added up, as an estimate (0.00 for a percentage or guarantee program) |
| neither | nothing |

## Cases (hypothetical credit records)

- Award entries of 1500.00 USD and 750.00 USD on the customer's credits, of which 500.00 USD was reduced: the standing balance, 1750.00 USD, is added.
- An award of 1000.00 USD booked and later applied in full at an earlier closing: an award has been booked, so the standing balance, 0.00 USD, is added.
- No award booked; a credit reserved against the file under a program with a fixed credit amount of 1000.00 USD and another reserved under a percentage program: 1000.00 USD plus 0.00, which is 1000.00 USD, is added as an estimate.
- No award booked and nothing reserved against the file: nothing is added.
